mapper.select: SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN C_SMALL_CD = '001' THEN S_VALUE END) AS MAIN_IMG, MAX(CASE WHEN C_SMALL_CD = '002' THEN S_VALUE END) AS MAIN_TEXT FROM T_LD_CODE WHERE C_BIG_CD = '10' GROUP BY C_BIG_CD

SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN C_SMALL_CD = '001' THEN S_VALUE END) AS DEV_NM, MAX(CASE WHEN C_SMALL_CD = '002' THEN S_VALUE END) AS DEV_PART, MAX(CASE WHEN C_SMALL_CD = '003' THEN S_VALUE END) AS DEV_IMG, MAX(CASE WHEN C_SMALL_CD = '004' THEN S_VALUE END) AS DEV_TEXT, MAX(CASE WHEN C_SMALL_CD = '005' THEN S_VALUE END) AS DEV_MSG, MAX(CASE WHEN C_SMALL_CD = '006' THEN S_VALUE END) AS DEV_TAG FROM T_LD_CODE WHERE C_BIG_CD = '20' GROUP BY C_BIG_CD

SELECT S_COMPANY_NM COMPANY_NM, CONCAT(SUBSTR(C_START_DY,1,4), '.', SUBSTR(C_START_DY,5,2)) START_DY, CASE WHEN C_ING_YN = 'Y' THEN '재직중' ELSE CONCAT(SUBSTR(C_END_DY,1,4), '.', SUBSTR(C_END_DY,5,2)) END END_DY, S_GRADE_NM GRADE_NM, S_SMALL_CONT SMALL_CONT, S_EXP_DETAIL EXP_DETAIL FROM T_LD_EXPERIENCE_INFO WHERE C_USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY C_ING_YN DESC, C_START_DY DESC

SELECT C_PROJECT_SEQ PROJECT_SEQ, S_PROJECT_NM PROJECT_NM, S_TAG PROJECT_TAG, IFNULL(S_SUM_IMG, '/images/landingDoobo/project/img_ing.png') SUM_IMG, DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(C_START_DY, '%Y%m%d'), '%Y.%m') START_DY, DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(C_END_DY, '%Y%m%d'), '%Y.%m') END_DY FROM T_LD_PROJECT_INFO WHERE C_USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY C_PROJECT_SEQ DESC
SELECT S_FAQ_QUESTION FAQ_QUESTION, S_FAQ_ANSWER FAQ_ANSWER FROM T_LD_FAQ_LIST WHERE C_USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY C_FAQ_SEQ

SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN C_SMALL_CD = '001' THEN S_VALUE END) AS CONTACT_MAIL, MAX(CASE WHEN C_SMALL_CD = '002' THEN S_VALUE END) AS CONTACT_CALL, MAX(CASE WHEN C_SMALL_CD = '003' THEN S_VALUE END) AS CONTACT_TALK FROM T_LD_CODE WHERE C_BIG_CD = '30' GROUP BY C_BIG_CD

SELECT C_PROJECT_SEQ PROJECT_SEQ, S_PROJECT_NM PROJECT_NM, S_TAG PROJECT_TAG, DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(C_START_DY, '%Y%m%d'), '%Y.%m') START_DY, DATE_FORMAT(STR_TO_DATE(C_END_DY, '%Y%m%d'), '%Y.%m') END_DY, IFNULL(S_SUM_IMG, '') SUM_IMG, IFNULL(S_DETAIL_IMG, '') DETAIL_IMG, S_DETAIL_CONT DETAIL_CONT FROM T_LD_PROJECT_INFO WHERE C_PROJECT_SEQ = #{projectSeq} AND C_USE_YN = 'Y'
